name: OfficeQA
intro: OfficeQA（OfficeQA Full）以 1939–2025 年美国财政部公报为语料，覆盖约 89,000 页和超过 2,600 万个数值。问题经独立答案复现、第三位标注员分歧复核、两轮智能体辅助质检与参数知识过滤后保留 246 题；两个构建期智能体都答对的 113 题标为 Easy，其余至少一个智能体未答对的 133 题标为 Pro。
build_method: 人工命题与扩展标注, 独立答案复现与分歧复核, 两轮智能体辅助质检, 参数知识过滤与双智能体难度划分
metric: 论文确定性正确率（精确匹配或绝对相对误差，默认0.0%）；固定reward.py直接答案规则
modality: 文本, PDF文档, 表格, 图表
task_type: 文档问答, 检索增强Agent任务
eval_feature: 真实文档检索, 多页推理, 确定性评分
scale: 246道问题（113 Easy + 133 Pro）；约89,000页；超过2,600万数值
build_method_en: Human and Partner Question Authoring, Independent Answer Reproduction and Conflict Review, Two-round Agent-assisted QA, Parametric Filtering and Two-agent Difficulty Assignment
eval_feature_en: Real-document Retrieval, Multi-page Reasoning, Deterministic Grading
intro_en: OfficeQA (OfficeQA Full) is grounded in U.S. Treasury Bulletins from 1939–2025, spanning about 89,000 pages and more than 26 million numeric values. After independent answer reproduction, third-annotator conflict review, two rounds of agent-assisted QA, and parametric-knowledge filtering, 246 questions remain: both construction-time agents must be correct for a question to be labeled Easy (113); otherwise at least one agent is incorrect and the question is labeled Pro (133).
scale_en: 246 questions (113 Easy + 133 Pro); about 89,000 pages; more than 26M numeric values
metric_en: Paper Deterministic Accuracy (Exact Match or Absolute Relative Error; 0.0% Default) plus Fixed reward.py Direct-answer Rules

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-18. Primary paper snapshot: arXiv:2603.08655v1, submitted 2026-03-09 and still the only arXiv version at review time. The downloaded v1 PDF SHA-256 is 0cf442159f94e109edeaa99d0b01f0ecc80839e853c82fcf204960ebcdf2aca2; the matching arXiv TeX/source archive SHA-256 is f69b639296fbd58a99b0dcdd64ca85ae3d1623924a7f0cd60021110527f6023e. The diagram follows paper Sections 2.1–2.4, Appendix B, and Appendix E rather than inferring a workflow from the repository README. Corpus evidence: the paper describes U.S. Treasury Bulletins published monthly from 1939 through 1982 and quarterly thereafter, each about 100–200 pages, totaling about 89,000 pages and more than 26 million numerical values; fixed repository documentation names the operational range as 1939–2025. The source mixes prose, complex tables, figures, charts, nested headers, changing units, footnotes, and values revised across later issues. It transitions from physical scans to digital-native PDFs in 1996, and the authors remove embedded text layers to test document interpretability fairly. Construction evidence: the three stated desiderata are enterprise-document complexity, retrieval plus multi-step reasoning beyond parametric recall, and a single unambiguous verifiable answer. The authors created a seed set, then worked with SuperAnnotate and Turing; annotators received examples, generated questions from the corpus, avoided ungrounded trivia, and disambiguated fiscal versus calendar year and real versus nominal dollars. USAFacts reviewed topical relevance. A new annotator independently reproduced each answer from the PDF pages used to create the question; a differing result triggered third-annotator review. Two subsequent end-to-end QA passes used agents to propose alternative answers. Human reviewers classified each conflict as an agent failure, an equally valid answer under ambiguous wording, or a case where the alternative was correct and the gold was wrong; ambiguous questions were revised and incorrect gold answers were corrected. Filtering evidence: Claude Opus 4.5 and GPT-5.1 were used without corpus or external sources to remove parametric-only questions, leaving 246 retrieval-dependent questions. Those 246 were then run through construction-time agents powered by the same model families with Databricks Parsed documents. The exact difficulty rule is asymmetric: only questions that both agents answered correctly became Easy, yielding 113; every other question, meaning at least one agent was incorrect, became Pro, yielding 133. OfficeQA Full is the union of the 113 Easy and 133 Pro questions, not an independently authored split. Evaluation evidence: paper v1 evaluates Prompt Only, Web Search Enabled, Oracle PDF Pages plus Web Search, Oracle Parsed Pages plus Web Search, and full-corpus agents operating on PDF or parsed representations. The prompt requires maximum precision, a final value inside FINAL_ANSWER tags, and, for agents, the most up-to-date revision unless the question fixes an exact date or document. The paper says 99% of Pro answers are numerical, defines absolute relative error, reports 0.0%, 0.1%, 1.0%, and 5.0% thresholds, and uses 0.0% by default; it also describes normalization of punctuation, mathematical symbols, and abbreviations, combined text-number checks, and fuzzy non-numeric matching. Fixed code snapshot: official GitHub commit 86753108d69e149cc28abd346bb8c3ca1cbfc7cf (2026-06-13, the last commit before the review date) has README SHA-256 83bbb78cdeb440af84dedbb7bffbcc396a3df4938232d10ff799e2bd85f02d50 and reward.py SHA-256 0d91698c87df6d889339aac36f63ae0966607f169890b0bf8b472b26bfe8138f. That fixed reward.py is a post-paper implementation and adds direct-answer guards not stated at the paper metric level: it extracts the last FINAL_ANSWER, requires a single non-empty line of at most 250 characters, checks expected numeric arity and compatible explicit units, and includes bracketed numeric-list and incidental context-year handling. The dashed implementation branch prevents those later rules from being back-projected into paper v1. Fixed data snapshot: the official gated Hugging Face dataset revision is 763a8366abf2a3605c381d53586d844dc60fa756, dated 2026-07-14 with commit title 'Updating OfficeQA with latest version questions (#4)'. Its tree API identifies officeqa_full.csv with Git blob OID cc59c600c6bbdf04e5bcf31f43dd58f0c7b3978c and size 155,772 bytes, and officeqa_pro.csv with Git blob OID 8dc109a1611b29f79685b51e98f7de9cec463466 and size 87,909 bytes. Because access approval is required, this review could not independently recount rows or inspect answers inside the gated payload; the 246/133 counts and schema are therefore locked to the technical report and official README, while the exact payload revision and blob metadata make that limitation auditable. Paper-code-data drift is explicit: paper v1 says an exact-question-and-answer dataset was publicly available on GitHub, but the official README says that in May 2026 the CSVs, PDFs, and parsed documents moved to gated Hugging Face specifically to keep browsing agents from seeing the questions and answers; the July 14 revision then updated the question files after publication. The fixed README exposes the schema uid, question, answer, source_docs, source_files, and difficulty and documents three corpus representations: original PDFs about 4 GB, parsed JSON about 730 MB, and transformed text about 460 MB. Access is therefore marked partly public: the paper, code, metadata, FRASER source archive, and repository are public, while benchmark CSV contents require approval. The repository NOTICE assigns officeqa_full.csv and officeqa_pro.csv to CC BY-SA 4.0 and reward/corpus scripts to Apache 2.0. No official leaderboard was identified in the fixed paper, repository, or dataset card, so has_leaderboard remains false. The EN and ZH specs use identical node IDs, types, positions, and edge styles; every secondary source or implementation connector is explicitly dashed. Formal publication evidence [site-a11z-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 5485×545 (English) and 5485×545 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 5483×543 and 5483×543. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
